tagline: A grand tourer study in light, glass and air.

highlights.title: Designed from the air in.
highlights.intro: Every surface on Concept earns its place. The body is shaped by airflow first and styling second, which is why it looks the way it does.

items.title: Active aero
items.body: A flush rear deck rises at speed and settles at rest, adding downforce without a permanent wing.

items.title: Dual-motor drive
items.body: One motor per axle, torque split in milliseconds. Rear-biased in corners, balanced when you need grip.

items.title: 800 V architecture
items.body: A low, flat pack lowers the centre of gravity and charges from 10 to 80% in about 18 minutes.

items.title: Layered paint
items.body: Clearcoat over a pearl base creates depth that shifts with the light. Three finishes at launch.

items.title: Slim light signature
items.body: Matrix LED lamps sit behind a single dark lens, so the face reads as one clean shape.

items.title: Low, focused cabin
items.body: A driver-first cockpit with bolstered seats, physical controls for the essentials and a clear view out.

specs.title: The numbers.
specs.note: Concept figures are design targets. This is a design study, not a production vehicle.

finishes.title: Pick a colour. See it live.
finishes.intro: Each finish is a real material variant in the 3D model. Choose one to try it in the configurator, where you can also change the wheels and calipers.

items.name: Carmine Candy
items.body: A deep, saturated red with a glassy clearcoat. Loud in sunlight, rich in shade.

items.name: Pearly Swirly
items.body: A soft pearl white with a faint iridescent shift that turns lilac and blue at the edges.

items.name: Torched Graphite
items.body: A dark metallic grey with a burnt, warm undertone. Understated until the light hits it.

items.q: Where does the 3D model come from?
items.a: It is the Car Concept sample model from the Khronos Group glTF Sample Assets, based on a public-domain model by Unity Fan, and licensed CC BY 4.0. Full credit is in the footer.
Yes. Yes. Open the Customize chapter to change the paint colour and finish, the rims and the brake calipers. Your choices are remembered in this browser.

items.q: The page feels slow on my device. What can I do?
items.a: The model is about 11 MB and rendered live with WebGL. A first load on a slow connection takes a moment. A recent browser with hardware acceleration enabled gives the best result.

items.q: What does the Register interest form do?
items.a: It is a demo. Nothing is sent anywhere. Wire it to your own backend or mailing list service before using it for real.

reserve.title: Register your interest.
reserve.body: Leave your details and we'll tell you if Concept ever becomes more than a concept.

speedTest.note: Simulated from the concept's target figures (0–100 km/h in 2.9 s, limited to 290 km/h). It is a demonstration, not a measurement.
